content.text: {"heavy-calm":"The worker's profile sits in deep navy shadow, cap pulled low, goggles catching a cool white light. There is a quiet inwardness here that can keep you company.","mid-calm":"Flat planes of mustard, tan and navy hold everything in place. Nothing hurries in this design, and the steady profile gives your eye an even place to rest.","bright-calm":"The warm yellow sky lends some ease, though the poster leans more serious than gentle. Let that glow carry you while the calm, shaded face keeps things grounded.","heavy-mid":"Those round goggles, blank and gleaming, make the face both guarded and watchful. It is a grave, thoughtful image about labor and care, weighty without turning grim.","mid-mid":"Here is the everyday made graphic: a working man in profile, distant silhouettes digging on a tan hill. Its balance of plain shapes feels steady and honest.","bright-mid":"Hope shows up in the small figures at work against the yellow sky, building something together. The poster's warmth is practical, a quiet faith in looking after one another.","heavy-charged":"The dark mass of cap and coat presses against the bright sky, giving the profile a tense, defiant edge. It answers stormy feeling with resolve rather than drama.","mid-charged":"Bold block lettering across the top and that sharp white collar line give the design an alert, ready pulse. It shares your restless energy and points it toward purpose.","bright-charged":"Joy here is more grit than celebration, but the punchy contrast of yellow against navy has real snap. Let its confident lettering and gleaming lenses lend your high spirits some backbone."}

{"heavy-calm":"The broad gray cloud pressing over the low shoreline holds a quiet weight, and the dark, still water below lets you sit with it without being rushed.","mid-calm":"Ships rest at anchor on flat brown water, sails furled, under a wide sky. Everything here waits unhurriedly, much as you seem to want to.","bright-calm":"A thin band of pale gold light along the horizon warms the long town and hills, a gentle brightness that stays soft rather than loud.","heavy-mid":"Small red and white flags flutter above heavy hulls before a distant walled town, a sober record of trade and distance that rewards slow, thoughtful looking.","mid-mid":"Sky, shore and water sit in three steady bands, with the ships placed just off center. It is an even, ordinary order you can rest your eye on.","bright-mid":"Patches of clear blue open between the clouds, and the far hills catch a mild light. The scene carries a quiet hope of arrival.","heavy-charged":"If your mood feels stormy, the towering cloud here has already spent its threat. It hangs heavy yet calm, offering a place to let tension settle.","mid-charged":"Restless energy can find an outlet in the tiny details: rowing boats, figures on the bank, rigging lines. Then the wide calm water slows you down.","bright-charged":"Your liveliness meets a gentler pace here. The bright little flags give a spark of color, while the vast sky asks your joy to breathe more slowly."}

{"heavy-calm":"The great arch sits in deep plum shadow, heavy and still, yet pale sky shows through its openings. You can rest in that quiet weight and still find light.","mid-calm":"Two riders pause on horseback beneath the rock, small and unhurried. The whole scene moves at their pace, slow, even, content to look.","bright-calm":"A soft gradient of blue sky warms toward cream behind the stone. It is a gentle, sunlit stillness that matches a mood already at ease.","heavy-mid":"Frank S. Nicholson lets the mauve rock fill nearly the whole sheet, ancient and massive. Its gravity suits a thoughtful mind, offering patience rather than gloom.","mid-mid":"Flat bands of tan, plum and sage stack into a clear, steady design. Nothing strains here, just a good day in open country, plainly told.","bright-mid":"The twisted juniper in the corner holds its sage leaves up to the warm sand. It carries the easy hope of a trip just beginning.","heavy-charged":"Stormy feelings may find relief in that hollowed arch, where wind and time already did their violent work long ago and left only calm behind.","mid-charged":"Restless energy has somewhere to go in the wide sloping desert and the tall lettering in soft blue gray along the bottom, a call to get moving.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance meets a quieter wonder here. The bright windows of sky punched through red rock deliver awe, a slower joy to sit beside yours."}

{"heavy-calm":"The mother's lowered, faraway gaze holds a quiet sorrow beside her tenderness, a stillness that can sit with you when your own thoughts turn inward.","mid-calm":"Deep blue robes fall in long, unhurried folds, and the soft hills behind them fade into pale distance. Everything here moves at the pace of a slow breath.","bright-calm":"Look at the child's warm, rosy skin and copper curls against her gentle hands. It is a small, glowing moment of care, completely at rest.","heavy-mid":"Her eyes seem to look past the child toward something coming, and that knowing gravity gives weight to an otherwise tender scene you can think alongside.","mid-mid":"A plain stone ledge across the bottom steadies the whole picture, setting mother and child in an ordinary, grounded place where feeling stays even and calm.","bright-mid":"Behind them, the sky opens into soft blue with a bright band of morning light over the hills, a hopeful horizon beside all that closeness.","heavy-charged":"Against the storm in you, the bright red cloth behind her hangs perfectly still. It offers a firm, warm wall to lean on until things settle.","mid-charged":"The child's upturned face and lifted gaze carry the only motion here. Follow that small look upward and let your restless energy slow to its quiet attention.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance will find a softer echo here: the child's plump hand clasped to his chest, the glint of fruit, a joy held close rather than shouted."}

{"heavy-calm":"A lone figure poles a low boat across water gone grey and still, and the far chimneys dissolve into mist. It keeps your quiet company without asking anything of it.","mid-calm":"Everything here moves at the pace of the boatman's single pole stroke. The soft grey river and faint reflections give you room to breathe slowly.","bright-calm":"The light here is dimmer than your mood, but the gentle haze softens every edge. Small glints on the water offer a calm warmth of their own.","heavy-mid":"Tall chimneys stand like dark markers against the fog, weighty yet half erased. Whistler lets that gravity settle in, giving your thoughts a steady place to rest.","mid-mid":"A plain evening on the Thames at Battersea, a worker crossing, lamps reflected on the water. Its ordinary rhythm matches a day that is simply holding steady.","bright-mid":"Hope here is quiet, carried by a few small lights trembling on the river. It offers your easy mood a hushed, reflective evening to wander into.","heavy-charged":"Where your feeling runs stormy, this river lies flat and windless under soft grey air. The still boat can be a place to set the tension down.","mid-charged":"Your restlessness meets a scene where only one figure moves, slowly, across misty water. Let the hazy shoreline slow your pulse for a moment.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance finds a hushed counterpoint in these muted greens and greys. The lone boatman offers a quiet pause between bursts of joy."}

{"heavy-calm":"The lowered eyelids and the still tray give you company in quiet. This poster is gentler than your mood, but its deep blue ground holds the hush you carry.","mid-calm":"A teapot and one small cup, carried without a wobble. The even pace of this serving gesture matches an unhurried hour, nothing rushed, nothing spilled.","bright-calm":"Warm yellow hands and a half-yellow face glow softly against cool grey and blue. It shares your easy rest, a tender moment of tea about to be poured.","heavy-mid":"Made during hard years for working people, the poster carries real weight beneath its calm. The closed eyes feel thoughtful, a person steadying herself through careful labor.","mid-mid":"Here is the dignity of an ordinary task: a tray held level, a cup on its saucer. Its balance of blue and grey suits a steady, everyday frame of mind.","bright-mid":"Those yellow gloves read like small suns at the tray's corners. The serene face and tidy shapes offer the kind of quiet hopefulness that sits easily with yours.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, this offers a counterweight: a level tray, a lidded pot, eyes gently shut. Its stillness gives your tension somewhere calm to land.","mid-charged":"The tall yellow lettering climbing the right edge carries some of your alertness, yet the figure below stays composed. It shows restless energy channeled into a careful, steady hand.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance will find a softer echo here, in the bright yellow splitting the face into light and shade. It is warmth at a slower tempo, a breather between bursts."}

{"heavy-calm":"Two children lie on a giant brown book drifting over the mountains, absorbed and quiet. When you feel low and still, their unhurried reading offers a gentle place to rest your eyes.","mid-calm":"The pale blue ribbon winds slowly down the sheet like a river, carrying a book and its two readers along at an easy, unhurried pace that matches yours.","bright-calm":"Soft sky blue, warm tan and spring green keep everything mild here. The boy on his stomach, chin in hands, holds the same contented ease you're feeling.","heavy-mid":"When thoughts weigh on you, the open-ended flight of this book over pine-dotted peaks suggests another way to carry them: lightly, with curiosity, the way children read.","mid-mid":"Clean shapes and a steady curving path give this poster an everyday calm order. A girl peers over the book's edge, curious but grounded, much like a balanced day.","bright-mid":"Hopeful and easy, the poster lets a book become a flying carpet. The girl's lean toward the edge, peeking at the green trees below, carries your warm anticipation.","heavy-charged":"Against stormy feelings, this quiet airborne book offers a way out. Its soft curves and small sloping mountains lower the temperature without asking you to pretend.","mid-charged":"The lettering swoops along the blue curve as if racing across the sheet, and the kicked-up feet of the boy share your restless urge to go somewhere.","bright-charged":"Joy here travels on a book soaring over bright green pines, two children thrilled by the ride. Big, bold dark lettering below cheers your lively mood on."}

{"heavy-calm":"Against a heavy, quiet mood, the lone blue inkwell offers a still center, a small vessel waiting for words you may not be ready to write yet.","mid-calm":"The quill rests upright in its blue inkwell, unhurried and patient, a pause before writing that suits an even, restful hour.","bright-calm":"Warm mustard gold surrounds a glossy blue inkwell, and the soft curl of the rust feather feels gentle, like a letter written slowly in good light.","heavy-mid":"For a thoughtful, weighty mood, the quill and ink hint at serious writing, though the sunny gold ground keeps that gravity from settling too deep.","mid-mid":"Bold black lettering stacked cleanly on gold, with a single quill and inkwell, gives the steady order of a well-made everyday notice.","bright-mid":"The rust quill sweeps upward with loose, curling barbs, hopeful and easy, as if the next line of a romance is already forming.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, this poster answers with warmth instead, its broad gold field and tidy blue shapes acting as a calm counterweight to tension.","mid-charged":"Restless energy finds an ally in the big tilted black word on the right, leaning forward with urgency beside a quill poised to move.","bright-charged":"The feather flares like a flame above the shining blue bottle, and the bright gold background hums with the playful joy of opening night."}

{"heavy-calm":"The river lies almost glassy under late autumn trees, their rust leaves doubled in the water. Its stillness can hold a quiet, inward mood without asking you to lift it.","mid-calm":"A lone rower rests his oars across a mirror-flat river. That pause between strokes matches an unhurried mood, steady and in no rush to arrive anywhere.","bright-calm":"Soft afternoon light warms the pale yellow hull and the bare-armed rower. Thin streaks of white cloud drift overhead, gentle and easy, like a day settling down.","heavy-mid":"Bare branches and fading foliage give this calm river a wistful, end-of-season weight. The single figure looking back seems lost in thought, as you might be.","mid-mid":"Everything here keeps its place: the iron bridge spanning the water, the boats spaced along the river, the long horizon. An ordinary afternoon, held in careful balance.","bright-mid":"Clear blue sky and the golden boat carry a quiet hopefulness. The scene feels like an easy outing, warm light on water and nothing pressing to do.","heavy-charged":"Against a stormy mood, this river offers a breath of stillness. The smooth reflections and long horizontal lines can slow a racing mind and let tension drain away.","mid-charged":"Restless energy might find its outlet in the rower's long oars, built for speed though paused now. The calm surface shows power at rest, ready but unspent.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance meets a softer echo here: sunlit autumn color and a small red boat sculling under the bridge. Joy turned down to a contented, glowing hum."}

{"heavy-calm":"The clenched hand holds its torch without wavering, a steadiness you may recognize in your own stillness, though the flame offers a small warmth to lean toward.","mid-calm":"Pale stars float loosely on the brushed blue ground, giving the image an unhurried rhythm beneath the raised fist and its quiet, constant flame.","bright-calm":"Against the soft cream paper, the torch flame flickers in warm red and orange, a gentle glow that can sit beside your ease without disturbing it.","heavy-mid":"The title's word challenge, set in sober dark lettering, carries real weight, and the gripped torch suggests something serious held onto with care.","mid-mid":"A single hand, a torch, a field of stars: the design is plain and sturdy, as balanced and dependable as an ordinary good day.","bright-mid":"Hope runs through that lifted torch, its flame brushed in quick warm strokes above a sky of pale stars, steady and quietly optimistic.","heavy-charged":"That tight fist and the ragged edges of the blue field hold real tension, turning stormy feeling into resolve rather than letting it scatter.","mid-charged":"Energy gathers in the upward thrust of the arm, every knuckle tensed, the flame pulling higher as if the restlessness you feel has somewhere to go.","bright-charged":"Red flame, deep blue, scattered white stars: the colors burst upward with the raised torch, a lively, defiant celebration you can share."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you feel low and still, the flat sky blue and the open book drawn in a thin yellow line offer a quiet, wry lift rather than matching your weight.","mid-calm":"The wide field of soft blue gives this poster an even, unhurried ground, though the tumbling black figure adds a small wink to your rest.","bright-calm":"Gentle sky blue and pale yellow outlines keep things light here, and the open book lies spread like a page you might return to at leisure.","heavy-mid":"Beneath the joke sits a serious point about care for books; the figure pressing down on the open spine gives your thoughtful mood something to turn over.","mid-mid":"Clean shapes, three plain colors and a clear message make this an everyday kind of good sense, steady and easy to live with.","bright-mid":"The upside-down figure with its yellow sleeves and hopeful silliness carries the easy warmth you are in, a lesson told with a smile.","heavy-charged":"For a stormy mind, this offers relief instead of drama: a figure flipped headfirst onto a book turns tension into a short laugh.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs through the jagged black limbs and the bouncy hand-lettered line below, a poster that seems caught mid-tumble.","bright-charged":"Tall white letters stand up like a cheer, and the cartwheeling figure above them shares your lively, playful spark."}

{"heavy-calm":"The dark tree mass at left holds deep shadow over still water, a quiet corner where your somber mood can rest while the field opens beyond.","mid-calm":"A lone ploughman walks behind his horses at an unhurried pace, and the long flat field lets your eye settle along its even horizon.","bright-calm":"Brightness breaks through the clouds onto pale furrows, a gentle light that warms the dark gray print without disturbing its quiet.","heavy-mid":"Heavy clouds press low over the ploughed earth, and the slow work beneath them carries the gravity and patience you are feeling.","mid-mid":"Here is an ordinary working day: a plough, a team of horses, a windmill turning. Its steadiness sits easily beside your own.","bright-mid":"Spring weather in mezzotint, with sunlight spilling across the field after rain. The title's promise of renewal quietly answers your hopeful mood.","heavy-charged":"Storm clouds churn across most of the sky in deep blacks and silvery whites, a turbulence that matches your tension while the land below holds firm.","mid-charged":"Birds scatter through a restless, wind-driven sky and the windmill's sails catch the gust, all that motion echoing your alert energy.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance finds its spark in the bright burst of cloud at center, though the print stays more brooding than joyful, a grounding note beneath your lift."}

{"heavy-calm":"The single blue eye, half-lidded and fixed on its work, carries a quiet concentration you may recognize, though the angled shapes around it hum with more motion than stillness.","mid-calm":"Thin cream rings ripple out from the eye like a slow thought spreading. Even amid the bold geometry, that patient act of looking keeps an unhurried pace.","bright-calm":"Soft olive ground and a warm rust panel give this poster a gentle glow, and the steady gaze into the microscope feels more like absorbed curiosity than strain.","heavy-mid":"A sharp black triangle slices behind the microscope, lending weight to the scene. It suits a grave mood by turning heaviness into focused, deliberate attention.","mid-mid":"Here is the everyday rhythm of careful work: one eye, one instrument, a tilted olive field. The balance of rust, black and cream holds everything steady.","bright-mid":"The deep blue lettering of the title rises with a confident, upright beat at the bottom, offering a hopeful note of curiosity rewarded and things yet to learn.","heavy-charged":"Rough, feathered edges where rust meets black give the face a restless tension. That charged angle can hold a stormy mood and point it toward something to solve.","mid-charged":"Everything leans: the tall slanted lettering, the tilted microscope, the rings pulsing from the eye. It matches restless energy with a mind already at full alert.","bright-charged":"Those radiating cream circles read like a spark of discovery, and the playful mix of thin script and bold blue capitals carries real lift for a lively mood."}

{"heavy-calm":"His black damask suit nearly dissolves into the dim gray wall, and that quiet merging of figure and shadow matches the still, inward place you are in.","mid-calm":"Nothing hurries here. One hand rests on his hip, the other loosely holds a pale glove, a pose of unforced patience that suits an even, restful hour.","bright-calm":"Against all that dark cloth, the lace ruff glows a soft white around his face, a small gentle light you can rest your eyes on while you stay at ease.","heavy-mid":"His steady, slightly weary gaze carries real weight. For a grave, thoughtful mood, he looks back at you like someone who has also been thinking things through.","mid-mid":"A hat set on a table, a glove in hand, a level look: this is a portrait of an ordinary composed day, as steady as the one you are having.","bright-mid":"The olive gold cloth on the table at right adds a warm note to the somber room, a modest hint of ease beside his serious dark clothes.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood storms, this painting holds still. The heavy black cloak and calm stance offer ballast, a figure who stands firm while things churn.","mid-charged":"Your restlessness meets a man at complete rest. Let the slow pattern woven into his dark sleeves pull your attention in and quiet it a little.","bright-charged":"For an exuberant mood, he is a sober counterpoint. The crisp lace at his cuffs is his only flourish, a reminder that joy can also sit quietly."}

{"heavy-calm":"The black piano body fills most of the sheet like a quiet room at night. Its stillness can hold your somber mood, while the tilted keys hint at sound to come.","mid-calm":"Cream space surrounds the dark grand piano, leaving room to breathe. You get an unhurried evening of listening, set out in tidy columns of dates.","bright-calm":"The soft rust red and warm cream feel gentle rather than loud. Here is a mellow companion for your restful lightness, like music drifting from an open window.","heavy-mid":"A heavy black piano tilts across the page, grave in its mass. It meets your thoughtful weight with something solid, then offers the promise of an evening's music.","mid-mid":"Clean lettering and a calendar of weekly concerts give this poster an everyday rhythm. It feels steady and useful, like a routine you would actually look forward to.","bright-mid":"The curved band of lettering rides along the piano's lid like a melody rising. Its easy optimism matches your hopeful mood, an open door to free music.","heavy-charged":"Diagonals slash the sheet, the piano keys racing toward the corner. That tension can carry your stormy feeling, though the warm red softens it into anticipation more than conflict.","mid-charged":"Everything leans and slides here, from the angled rust block to the striped keys. Your restless energy finds a match in a design that seems ready to start playing.","bright-charged":"Bouncy, tall lettering and the jaunty tilt of the piano feel playful and alive. It brings your joy a soundtrack, eight summer evenings of music waiting to happen."}

{"heavy-calm":"Where you are quiet and low, this poster offers a lift: a yellow sun rising behind a dark blue ship, a small warmth you can keep at the edge of stillness.","mid-calm":"The white corn stalks stand upright and simple at either side, giving this lively sheet a steady frame that suits an unhurried, even day.","bright-calm":"Cream paper, soft yellow and deep blue keep things gentle here, and the round sun sits like a warm lamp over the water for you to rest beside.","heavy-mid":"The ship tilting up its blue swell has real weight to it, though the bright lettering pulls the mood toward hope rather than gravity, a lighter companion for heavy thoughts.","mid-mid":"Two colors, cleanly printed, doing honest work: the poster has the balanced, practical cheer of a well-made everyday thing, sure of its message and calm in its layout.","bright-mid":"That yellow circle at the bottom, with its looping script, feels like an easy, open invitation, warm and hopeful in the way a sunny morning is.","heavy-charged":"Your storm finds its echo in the ship heaving up a steep blue wave, but the sunlit yellow overhead keeps it from tipping into dread.","mid-charged":"Bold block letters slanting up the page and wavy lines streaming from the ship give this poster a forward push that matches a restless, ready-to-go energy.","bright-charged":"Big yellow letters bounce across the blue like they can hardly wait, and the shouted circle below adds a joyful jolt, all momentum and good spirits."}

{"heavy-calm":"The central figure sits utterly still, hands folded in the lap, eyes lowered. If you feel somber and inward, this quiet gaze keeps you company without asking you to lift.","mid-calm":"Crossed legs resting on a broad lotus of rust and pale green give this work its unhurried rhythm, matching a restful mood that needs nothing more than steady breathing.","bright-calm":"A soft halo of red and cream rings the serene face, and the faded warmth of the cloth feels gentle, a light kind of rest held close.","heavy-mid":"Worn edges and centuries of fading give this painting real weight. For a grave, thoughtful mood, the calm seated figure offers depth that has already endured much.","mid-mid":"Small attendant figures line up in tidy rows around the center, an ordered, balanced arrangement that suits an everyday steadiness and rewards a slow look.","bright-mid":"Look at the faint smile and the necklaces of red beads draped across the chest. Hopeful ease lives here, quiet rather than loud, warm in its muted reds.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, the wide symmetry of this seated figure acts as an anchor, its folded hands holding still while everything around you churns.","mid-charged":"Restless energy can find a place to settle in the lowered eyes and centered pose, a counterweight that slows you down without dulling your alertness.","bright-charged":"Its joy is a quieter cousin of yours, glowing in the rosy lotus petals and crowded ring of companions, a calm celebration for when exuberance wants a pause."}

{"heavy-calm":"The dark grey robe falls in long, heavy folds to the pink floor, a quiet weight that can hold your stillness without asking you to lift it.","mid-calm":"Open books rest on wooden shelves and nothing hurries here. The study keeps an unhurried pace, matching yours, with time enough to read and simply stand.","bright-calm":"Look at the gold halo and the warm pink floor; their soft glow gives your gentle mood a calm, sheltered room to settle into.","heavy-mid":"A bowed head over a patient lion: Lorenzo Monaco paints thought as something carried slowly, a fitting companion when your mind feels grave and full.","mid-mid":"Shelves of blue, red and green books stand in neat order around the figure, an everyday steadiness that suits a balanced, ordinary day.","bright-mid":"The lion lifts its paw toward the gentle hand, a small act of trust that answers your hopeful mood with quiet tenderness rather than cheer.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood storms, this panel stays still. The calm downward gaze and folded robe offer a place to set the tension down for a while.","mid-charged":"If you feel restless, the tilted shelves and slanting desk give your eye somewhere to wander while the standing figure slowly steadies you.","bright-charged":"Your joy will find no dancing here, but the gleam of gold behind the shelves offers a softer brightness, a pause inside your lively day."}

{"heavy-calm":"Under that deep navy sky, the snowy peak holds perfectly still. If you feel quiet and inward, its pale, unmoving mass gives your stillness somewhere wide to rest.","mid-calm":"The broad green meadow curves slowly toward the trees, unhurried as an afternoon. Its flat, even shapes match a restful mood without asking anything of you.","bright-calm":"Soft peach and rose bands warm the mountain's snow like late sun. It is gentle light at rest, a calm that feels kind rather than empty.","heavy-mid":"The dark wall of pines sits heavy beneath the bright summit, a weighty band of shadow. It gives grave thoughts a solid shape, then lifts your eye upward.","mid-mid":"Five small tents sit in the meadow with the ordinary ease of a settled camp. Steady, balanced, everyday, much like the mood you bring.","bright-mid":"Bold, rounded letters in navy and warm tan promise a welcome. The poster carries an easy, hopeful openness, like a trip still ahead of you.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood storms, this offers a clear sky and a mountain that will not move. Its quiet layered snow works as a steady counterweight to tension.","mid-charged":"A lone rider gallops across the meadow, the one quick motion in the scene. Your restless energy finds that small figure, then the vast calm around it.","bright-charged":"The cheerful stacked forms of peach, cream and lilac have a lively, cut-paper joy. It is calmer than your exuberance, but shares its sunny spirit."}

{"heavy-calm":"When you feel low and quiet, the deep brown ground under this bowl gives weight to settle on, while the orange fruit offers a small, patient warmth.","mid-calm":"A hand reaches unhurriedly for a grape, and the round bowl holds everything evenly in place. It suits a restful, steady mood without asking much of you.","bright-calm":"Soft yellow pears and dotted oranges sit gently together, tender as a kitchen table at rest. The warmth here is mild, close to how you feel.","heavy-mid":"For a grave, thoughtful mood, the fruit's ripe roundness answers with care and nourishment. The solid brown blocks keep it grounded, so the lightness never feels flippant.","mid-mid":"Balance is the whole idea: a circle of fruit set on a crisp chevron of yellow lines, everything weighed and orderly, like a good ordinary day.","bright-mid":"Orange, mustard and cream sit together like a warm promise of care. The reaching hand carries the same easy hope you are feeling.","heavy-charged":"Against a stormy mood, this offers a counterweight: plain fruit, a careful hand, a sturdy bowl. Its calm geometry can slow your breathing a little.","mid-charged":"The striped yellow lines cut a sharp V down the sheet, giving restless energy a clean direction, while the fruit above keeps things playful.","bright-charged":"Bold, blocky orange lettering and fruit stacked high meet your joy with cheer of their own, though its pace is gentler than your exuberance."}

{"heavy-calm":"When things feel heavy, the soft gray wash here stays quiet with you, and the two blank shields wait unwritten, asking nothing of a still, inward mood.","mid-calm":"Ribbons tied in loose bows hold two empty shields aloft, and the whole drawing moves at an unhurried pace that matches your restful, even frame of mind.","bright-calm":"A plump winged child floats on soft clouds, curls catching light, and the gentle brown ink keeps everything warm and at rest, much like you.","heavy-mid":"Against a grave, weighty mood, Louis Fabritius Dubourg offers a light counterweight: two blank shields, still waiting for whatever meaning you might give them.","mid-mid":"The double ruled border frames a small, steady scene of a child holding up two shields, an everyday kind of balance drawn in calm gray wash.","bright-mid":"Hopeful and easy, the child reaches up with both arms, gazing toward the ribbons, carrying the shields as if they weighed almost nothing at all.","heavy-charged":"Stormy feelings may find relief in these puffy clouds and tender gray shading, a quiet place to set down tension rather than another source of it.","mid-charged":"Your restless energy meets the kicking leg and outstretched arms of the floating child, though the drawing gently slows that motion into something softer.","bright-charged":"The playful sprawl of a winged child tumbling on clouds shares your joy, if in a hushed register of brown ink rather than bright color."}

{"heavy-calm":"When you feel still and inward, this row of high-kicking legs pulls the other way, a bright counterweight whose red and blue stripes keep moving when you cannot.","mid-calm":"The figures stride in perfect step across a tilted blue panel. Its rhythm is steady and repeating, something your unhurried mood can watch without being rushed along.","bright-calm":"Warm red and cream carry a gentle cheer here, though the marching legs are livelier than your rest. Let the soft brushed edge of the blue field set the pace.","heavy-mid":"Behind the cheerful kicks sits a serious public plea about illness. The bold black lettering holds that weight, giving your thoughtful mood something grave beneath the play.","mid-mid":"Seven figures in matching stripes, each a step behind the last, make an orderly everyday parade. It shares your balance: lively, but keeping time.","bright-mid":"Easy optimism runs through those swinging arms and striped shirts. The upward tilt of the blue panel feels like hope set at an angle, ready to go.","heavy-charged":"Your storm finds a different outlet in this forward march, tension turned into stride. The diagonal lines and jutting boots push hard, defiant rather than dark.","mid-charged":"Restless energy has somewhere to go here. The kicking legs repeat like a drumbeat, and the streaked blue behind them reads as speed, matching your alert, full charge.","bright-charged":"Pure exuberance: a chorus line of kicks, red socks flashing, the lettering itself leaning in to join. It is as playful and lively as you feel right now."}
